alex_sales: Quick ask — customer FathomAI wants a 10-week pilot. They want reserved capacity $120k and a 30% discount for the pilot period. Need quick routing; customer requests decision within 48hrs. tagging @meera_dealdesk @sam_finance
meera_dealdesk: 30% triggers escalation in CPQ. Please fill these CPQ fields before intake: `approval_path__c=dealdesk+finance`, `discount_pct__c=30`, `commit_level__c=reserved_120k`, `priority__c=fastpath`. Put quote in folder `escalations/pilot-fastpath`.
alex_sales: Quote FTH-452-PILOT added with fields. Also attached the pilot SOW and acceptance criteria.
mika_se: Note — customer will need cross-region VPC access and log forwarding. Mark `security_review=true` if they will send sample telemetry.
sam_finance: Finance will accept 30% only with a billing floor of $72k and a 6-month clawback if usage < commit. Set `billing_floor__c=72000` and `clawback_term__c=6m` in CPQ.
meera_dealdesk: Acknowledge. I'll intake once billing floor and clawback are set. Triage SLA for fastpath is 2 business hours; routing to approvers within same day.
workflow-bot: Intake ticket DD-4812 created for FTH-452-PILOT and assigned to @meera_dealdesk — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DD-4812
tara_legal: I'll be on standby. If SOW has custom data retention or IP language, Legal needs to review; otherwise we can sign off after finance.
alex_sales: Customer is okay with billing floor and clawback. Pushing final SOW now. ETA 30m.
meera_dealdesk: Thanks. Once attachments are in I'll route to Finance and Legal. If finance approves, dealdesk can approve within the same day for this fastpath. :thumbsup:
